name: Lena Schmidt
bio:
Lena discovered her passion for motorsport early, spending countless hours in her grandfather's autobody shop, learning the intricacies of metalwork and vehicle construction. This hands-on experience ignited a desire to contribute to the racing world, leading her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering with a specialization in automotive technology.

Since graduating, Lena has worked with several smaller racing teams, honing her skills in fabrication, welding, and composite construction. She's known for her meticulous attention to detail and ability to quickly adapt to new challenges. Lena thrives in high-pressure environments and believes that continuous improvement is crucial for success in motorsport. She is particularly adept at identifying potential structural weaknesses and implementing innovative solutions to enhance vehicle performance and safety. Her background in both practical and theoretical engineering gives her a unique perspective, allowing her to bridge the gap between design and execution.

Lena is looking for a team where she can contribute her diverse skillset and continue to learn and grow as a fabricator. Her ambition extends beyond simply following instructions; she aims to be an integral part of a team pushing the boundaries of automotive technology.

physical.hairStyle: Long, usually tied back in a practical ponytail, with a few stray strands framing her face.
physical.description: Lena is of average height with a wiry build, reflecting years of hands-on work.

quirks: Always wears a pair of well-worn leather gloves, even when not actively working.
Has a habit of humming classical music while welding.
Keeps a small, well-organized toolbox that she never lets anyone else touch.
